title: Brighton Fringe Co-Branded Poster Misled Public While Knowing Venues Were Unsafe
claim: Brighton Fringe acted to protect audiences and their brand integrity through careful curation and risk management.
reality: Brighton Fringe approved and co-branded a Brighton Station poster campaign with Ben Carter’s Half a Camel Productions. The poster featured both logos and directed the public to the Fringe’s ticketing system, implying institutional safety and unity. At the time, the Fringe knew the advertised venues were uninsurable. The logo placement reassured the public while hiding operational collapse — and Carter was erased shortly after.

laws.why: Breach of trustee duties through misrepresentation
Failure to exercise reasonable care in marketing
